_note: Ground truth for the planted defects in data/novapump_srs.md. Written in Phase 1, before any pipeline code. Never edit to make an eval pass.

defects.description: Pediatric max bolus is 10 U in one requirement and 15 U in another.
Child Lock disables the Bolus button, but no requirement says what the pump does when the user presses it anyway.
Settings mode list omits Extended Bolus, which the Delivery mode list includes.
Traces to NP-SYS-007, which does not exist in the system requirements.

legacy_steps_that_must_not_be_reused._note: Secondary, informational check (not part of the 5/5 gate). Legacy steps referencing NP-100-only modes, buttons, or values that differ in NP-200.
